name: B10-0481/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an end to the fighting in Yemen and around the Red Sea. It condemns attacks by the Houthis on ships and on Saudi civilian sites, and attacks by Saudi-led forces that kill civilians. It asks all sides to stop, allow aid through, and return to United Nations talks. It also wants the European Union to keep its naval protection mission, add sanctions on those responsible for attacks, and push for war crimes investigations.

- The European Union is asked to extend its Red Sea naval mission past February 2027 and add sanctions on Houthi leaders.
- People affected: civilians in Yemen and Saudi Arabia, aid workers, and detained United Nations staff.
- Next: European Union governments and the foreign policy chief must respond; the Parliament has no power to decide alone.
